notes: The italic *goeth* is retained as `added` under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause. The competing reading treats it as the construction-supplied copula joining the `לִפְנֵי` predicate, on rule 20's sentence admitting *come* and other linking verbs; it was set aside because *go before* states a precedence the preposition already carries and adds a motion the Hebrew never writes, and because the parallel colon renders the same clause with no verb at all.
Both `לִפְנֵי` pairs fuse under rule 30 and head on the construct noun.
